name: spree
description: Claude Code support for Spree Commerce projects. Ships 26 skills covering project conventions, the customization decision tree (subscriber vs decorator vs dependency injection vs admin extension API vs resource generator), the API resource generator, decorator patterns for extending core Spree classes, the Spree.dependencies dependency-injection system (64 core + 233 API injection points) with the introspection rake tasks, the v3 REST API (Store + Admin, auth modes, scopes, prefixed IDs), legacy v2 migration, the TypeScript SDKs (@spree/sdk + @spree/admin-sdk including custom-endpoint extension), upgrades, the data model (Orders, Variants, Channels, Markets), events + subscribers + outbound webhooks (HMAC), extensions, catalog (Products, Variants, search), checkout (state machine + cart pipeline), payments (gateways, refunds, gift cards), promotions, pricing (incl. EU Omnibus), shipping + fulfillment, the legacy Rails admin, the React dashboard, the Next.js storefront, i18n (UI + Mobility data translations), testing (RSpec + Factory Bot + spree_dev_tools), security (Rails basics + Spree-specific), performance, and deployment. Includes the spree-expert subagent for multi-step Spree work and two safety hooks (block destructive db commands, warn on hardcoded secrets). Skills activate based on task context; the agent is invoked by Claude when complex multi-step Spree work warrants a fresh context.
